description: This is an Angular component source file for the header component in a frontend web application. It defines a UI component that handles user search input, emits events on input changes, and manages internal state related to search queries.

classes.name: HeaderComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing the header UI, including search input and event emission.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Handles input events from the search box, updates internal query state, and emits the search change event.

methods.name: clearSearch
methods.description: Clears the search input and emits an empty search change event.
